title: SKIT: What happened this time at COP31?
summary: Watch this skit to look back on how this year's heated climate negotiations went down

blocks.text: Watch this skit to look back on how this year's heated climate negotiations went down
MANILA, Philippines – The world is warming, and world leaders’ discussions on how to address this problem were just as heated.

The 31st United Nations (UN) Climate Change Conference (COP31) happened just as Filipinos started feeling the effects of a Super El Niño, which is expected to cause dry spells and drought all over the country over the next several months. With global temperature rise projected to cross 1.5°C within the next few years, this year’s COP was marked by calls for urgency.
Despite the intense negotiations running into overtime — making it the longest COP on record — no climate deal was reached.
What happened during climate negotiations over the past few weeks? Watch this video to look back on how it all went down. – Rappler.com
